title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Early Closure Terms: Relief by Earned Wage Access Fee Model
content:
**Relief clause.** An employer whose live Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement is on the employer-paid fee model earns 15 percent relief on the early closure fee of its Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service, one on the employer-sponsored fee model earns 10 percent, and any other employer earns no fee-model relief.

The fee model is the one recorded on the employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, which says who pays workers' transfer fees.

| Fee model on the live agreement | Fee-model relief |
|---|---|
| employer-paid | 15 percent |
| employer-sponsored | 10 percent |
| worker-paid | none |
| no live agreement | none |

**Questions the clause answers.**

*An employer's agreement is on the employer-paid model but its status is terminating. Is relief earned?* No; the agreement is not live, so the employer is among any other employers and earns no fee-model relief.

*Does the worker-paid model earn anything?* No; only the employer-paid and employer-sponsored models earn fee-model relief.
